# H.V.A (Hive Vault Arc)

## Identity

- Company: Hive Vault Arc (H.V.A)
- Positioning: H.V.A is an AI-powered digital transformation and technology consulting firm.
- Three pillars: (1) AI & Intelligent Automation, (2) Digital Transformation Programs, (3) Technology Consulting and Advisory.
- Descriptor: We design and deploy intelligent automation and AI agents, lead end-to-end digital transformation programs, develop custom software and cloud infrastructure, and provide strategic technology consulting — from roadmap to long-term production operations.
- Base: Tangier, Morocco
- Languages: English, French, Arabic, Spanish

## Three-Pillar Positioning

### Pillar 1 — AI & Intelligent Automation
The leading capability cluster. We build and deploy AI agents for customer operations, sales workflows, and internal processes. This includes WhatsApp AI agents, AI receptionists, lead qualification automation, decision intelligence dashboards, and workflow orchestration systems.

### Pillar 2 — Digital Transformation
End-to-end transformation programs: operational diagnostics, IT modernization, legacy system upgrades, cloud migration, data pipelines, and CRM transformation. We own transformation programs from strategy through production — not just the advisory layer.

### Pillar 3 — Technology Consulting
Strategic advisory layer: digital transformation roadmap design, operational diagnostics, architecture decisions, technology strategy for growth-stage and established businesses. Consulting is always paired with execution accountability.

## Engagement Model

- Engagement model: strategy advisory → architecture design → engineering execution → managed evolution.
- Operating style: founder-led, end-to-end ownership, outcome accountability.
- Delivery principle: not advice-only and not build-only; consulting and execution are always integrated.
- Partnership horizon: project launch through long-term maintenance and optimization.
- Discovery-first model with strategic and technical scoping before any scope is locked.

## Execution Capabilities

- AI agents and intelligent automation (WhatsApp, web, voice, internal workflows)
- Workflow automation, orchestration, and process redesign
- Decision intelligence and AI-powered analytics dashboards
- Digital transformation diagnostics and roadmap design
- CRM engineering, migration, and deep integration
- Custom software, SaaS, web, and mobile development
- IT modernization and legacy system upgrades
- Cloud infrastructure, DevOps, CI/CD, observability, and security
- Data services, KPI design, and executive analytics

## Transformation Proof

### 1) Multilingual WhatsApp AI Agent (Real Estate)

- Status: Live in production since October 2025
- Outcomes:
  - First response latency: <18 seconds
  - Manual triage reduction: 85%
  - Qualified meetings increase: +43%

### 2) CRM Transformation Program (Real Estate)

- Status: Live in production since May 2025
- Outcomes:
  - Pipeline visibility: 100%
  - Manual data-entry time: -40%
  - Tracked pipeline volume: $2.4M monthly

### 3) Executive Analytics Control Tower (Healthcare)

- Status: Live in production since January 2026
- Outcomes:
  - Reporting cycle time: -72%
  - KPI accuracy: 99.3%
  - Decision latency on anomalies: -58%

## Commercial Approach

- Discovery-first model with strategic and technical scoping.
- Pricing is private and discussed after discovery.
- Commercial structure is tailored to scope, complexity, integrations, and maintenance requirements.
